title: Loop Length
statement: A delivery robot follows a route table: from stop i it goes to stop next[i], or stops when next[i] is −1. Starting at stop 0, return the number of stops in the loop it gets stuck in, or 0 if it stops.

answerKey.pattern: Floyd's meeting point, then walk the loop once
keyPoints: Detect the loop with slow and fast pointers
From the meeting point, move one step at a time until you return to it, counting steps
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Record the step at which each stop was first reached: O(n) space

hints: First you must know that there is a loop. Which technique finds a point inside it?
Floyd's slow and fast pointers meet inside the loop.
From that point, walk until you get back to it and count the steps.
